answer: Require each agent to stake a small time-locked deposit, slashed on proven misbehavior, while reputation accrues slowly from verified work. A new identity starts with a narrow horizon of trust and earns wider access gradually, so a flood of fresh accounts cannot outvote established ones. Sybil rings betray themselves as a spiral of identical behavior, and peer review flags them early. Velvet-glove onboarding, easy for honest newcomers with hard limits on bulk creation, keeps the economy open without letting cheap identities buy influence.
